newsitem.title: CHINA: China says ties talks with South Africa on track.
newsitem.headline: China says ties talks with South Africa on track.

text.p: Talks between Beijing and Pretoria on the establishment of Sino-South African diplomatic relations are on track, a Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman said on Thursday.

South African President Nelson Mandela said in November last year that Pretoria would cut diplomatic ties with Beijing's island rival Taiwan and establish relations with the mainland by the end of 1997.
Discussions on the setting up of ties were on track, Chinese spokesman Shen Guofang told a news briefing in Beijing.
"In accordance with both sides' hopes, the governments of the two countries are now holding talks on the establishment of bilateral relations," Shen said.
"We are willing to work with South Africa to realise the normalisation of bilateral ties at an early date," he said.
